rule: Product summary tiles use median error
rationale: A handful of degenerate series-model pairs dominate any mean
observed_evidence: mean wape across accuracy_metrics = 6.697e+19 vs median = 0.06383

rule: All aggregates are series-weighted, never row-weighted
rationale: Backtest density differs by metric, so row weighting would silently over-weight the densest metric
observed_evidence: each series contributes one median value to every taxonomy scope

forbidden_statistic: any claim of global model superiority
rationale: A championship count reflects the cohort composition, not model quality

rule: No-signal champions are excluded from meaningful champion counts
rationale: Their champion is a tie-break among models that all scored zero error

rule: Model summaries must separate the three populations
primary_statistic: all technical champions | meaningful champions only | no-signal suppressed
rationale: Blending them reproduces exactly the defect P6C corrected

forbidden_statistic: coercing a missing median to zero
rationale: Turning missing into zero would make a broken series look perfect
observed_evidence: 16 series have a non-computable median wape
